scope_cutoff.boundary: The original intersection traffic was grouped by direction and SUMO ignored later flows because departures were out of order; intersection_sorted copies it with traffic sorted by (depart, departLane), so all three flows run. The marker explicitly says all three flows are active.

excluded_predecessor.evidence: Archived train_intersection_yield_v2_d1.py lines 1-12 documents the ignored-flow problem; traffic_00 inspection has only E2 -> E1 active route entries.
excluded_predecessor.instruction: Exclude initial intersection/yield_v2 and other one-flow results from the three-flow catalog.

depart_scale.4.0: For sorted explicit-vehicle XML, multiply every vehicle depart timestamp by 4.0; this widens departure gaps and lowers arrival density. It does not multiply the number of vehicles, a flow rate, or vehicle_scale.
depart_scale.1.0: Pass-through/no timestamp scaling. In random profiles demand comes from configured q or per-tick p; depart_scale=1.0 does not mean the same traffic as sorted scale 1.0.

probability_units.native_random_v1: SUMO <flow probability=q/3600> is per second; with dt=0.1 s its effective per-tick probability is q/36000.
probability_units.explicit_step_profiles: p05/p03/p02 and DARRL p values are per 0.1-second tick, pre-sampled into explicit vehicles; they are not native SUMO per-second probabilities.
probability_units.name_warning: standard medium_p05 means p=0.5; standard medium_p03/p02 mean 0.3/0.2. DARRL probabilities are decimal .03/.05/.07 (r1) and .015/.03/.05 (r2).

interpretation.comparison_boundary: All formal policy runs located use training seed 0. Cross-family score differences are descriptive, not a single-variable traffic comparison.

scene_families.full_method_note: A completed MST+SLT result exists as the complete-method/strong-baseline comparison. No completed final evaluation for named sac_mlp_d1_full was found; do not substitute MST+SLT or Topo+3slot for it.

shared.map_ego_types: Uses sorted map/ego and 120 source vTypes with route-conditional empirical type distributions; no DARRL lane/vType overrides.
shared.time: dt=0.1 s; requests during [0,130) s; ego route -E1 -> -E0 at 50 s from lane2, speed0; 600 raw-step control cap; action repeat3.
shared.generation: Native SUMO flow probability per second; seed domains split train/validation/test.

shared.map_ego_120_types: Same frozen map, ego, route and driver distributions as native medium; no DARRL minGap/jmIgnoreFoeProb overrides.
shared.generation: For each actual SUMO seed and route, a SHA256-derived Python RNG samples every 0.1 s tick over [0,130) before SUMO starts; requests become explicit vehicles. Same-seed planned arrivals are nested across p levels, but insertion/type draws and resulting traffic are not guaranteed paired.
shared.training_protocol: SAC+MLP fresh seed0, 100000 raw steps / 95001 updates, final validation n=100 per profile.

shared.generation: Explicit vehicles pre-sampled independently for each route and 0.1 s tick, not native SUMO probability flows.
shared.collision_detection: SUMO ego collision event or ego geometry overlap; not DARRL legacy distance/disappearance heuristic.
